en: A black-and-white postcard image depicting people relaxing at tables under parasols near an outdoor swimming pool surrounded by forest. Several people are swimming, and there are diving boards and a wooden fence around the pool. The scene is lively, with adults and children enjoying the recreational facility. The background is filled with dense trees, giving a serene, natural atmosphere. There is handwritten-style text at the bottom of the postcard.
